messages:
Ana (Design): quick sanity check — attaching the new request-drilldown snapshot flow screenshot. want eyes on CTA ordering and the little correlation chip placement :eyes:
Kevin (Eng): looks good overall. my worry: chip + export CTA are visually competing on small screens. could push export into a kebab menu for mobile?
Sam (PM): prefer keeping export visible for power users (fast snapshot download). maybe primary CTA = 'Copy permalink', secondary = 'Download snapshot' — prevents accidental downloads.
Lina (Design): agree with Sam. also thinking the correlation chip should be inline with metadata, not in the top-right chrome. keeps it contextual when you scroll stacktrace.
Jordan (A11y): two quick accessibility nits: 1) correlation chip needs an accessible name like `aria-label=\"Correlation ID: copy\"` and keyboard focus. 2) export menu should not rely on hover — ensure it's keyboard operable and has clear focus styles.
Ana (Design): updated microcopy proposals: primary: 'Copy permalink', secondary: 'Download snapshot (.json)'. tooltip for correlation chip: 'Copy correlation id to clipboard'. thoughts?
Kevin (Eng): implementation note — permalink copy is cheap, download snapshot requires server-side snapshot generation for large traces. we can async the generation and show a toast with link when ready. fine?
Sam (PM): that's fine, just make UX clear (spinner + toast). add analytics events: click_copy_permalink, click_download_snapshot_start, download_snapshot_complete.
Jordan (A11y): can we avoid ambiguous icon-only buttons? if we use an icon for export fallback, include visually-hidden label for screen readers. example:

```
<button aria-label="Download snapshot" class="icon-btn">📥</button>
```

Lina (Design): small visual idea — introduce a subtle divider between metadata row and action row so the correlation pill reads as part of metadata. also reduce chip contrast slightly; right now it screams.
Kevin (Eng): noted. Lina — can you drop the slightly reduced-contrast swatch into figma? i'll validate on 4:1 contrast rule for text inside chip.
Ana (Design): yes will upload a variant. also proposing keyboard shortcut `c` to copy correlation id when drilldown is focused — would that clash?
Kevin (Eng): might clash with other shortcuts. we have a global `c` binding in some places. we can scope it to when focus is inside the drilldown panel.
Jordan (A11y): if adding shortcut, publish it in the a11y help panel and ensure it can be discovered via a help command. announce via an `aria-live` polite region when copy succeeds: "Correlation id copied".
Sam (PM): question on ordering: primary CTA left or right? analytics suggests left-anchored primary leads to fewer accidental clicks. propose left: Copy permalink, right: more actions (kebab) with Download.
Lina (Design): left-anchored primary works for narrow widths too. we'll mock a collapsed state where 'more actions' becomes a single kebab.
Ana (Design): last thing — export file naming. suggest `trace-<corrid>-<short-ts>.json` to help debugging. Kevin, Jordan — any privacy concerns?
Kevin (Eng): file contains only trace metadata + stackframes (no PII). still need to strip any user identifiers per config. add option to include/exclude full request body.
Jordan (A11y): +1 on naming. ensure screen reader reads the download filename when download begins (some browsers announce it). otherwise include in the toast message.
ops-bot: build #frontend/5678 passed — deploy to staging queued. :rocket:
Ana (Design): awesome. I'll update figma with two variants (desktop + mobile collapsed) and a copy doc. tagging @Kevin and @Jordan for final sign-off once uploaded. :thumbsup:
